hypothesis: The exact two trained v37 rank-16 INT8/FP16 residual payloads can be executed directly on AMD AVX2 without expanding either factor: a fixed FMA/F16C kernel with only 16 FP32 scratch values will agree with the exported PyTorch algebra within 5e-4, beat the scalar C oracle by at least 1.25x, and conservatively add no more than 7.272727 ms per token even if all 64 layers were sensitivity-admitted.

scope.claim_boundary: exact trained residual microkernel only; not llama.cpp integration, whole-model quality, end-to-end throughput, energy, or breakthrough evidence

runtime_algebra.exported_form: output += bias_FP16 + ((input_FP32 @ left_INT8) * left_scale_FP16 * right_scale_FP16) @ right_INT8
runtime_algebra.left_layout: input_features by rank row-major signed INT8
runtime_algebra.right_layout: rank by output_features row-major signed INT8
runtime_algebra.avx2_schedule: accumulate the 16 left-code dot products in two eight-lane FP32 vectors, apply both FP16 component scales, then stream each of the 16 right-code rows into an eight-output FMA accumulator initialized from FP16 bias and add it to the live FP32 residual output

measurement.inputs: one deterministic FP32 Gaussian activation and base-output vector per exact trained payload; no benchmark or evaluation text is used
measurement.correctness_oracle: the existing exported Int8ResidualAdapter.correction PyTorch implementation using the same exact payload
measurement.safe_entry_checks: scalar and AVX2 safe C ABI calls must succeed before timing
measurement.statistic: median monotonic wall-clock nanoseconds per native call
measurement.pinning: one process pinned to physical CPU 0; no concurrent Qwen or llama workload
measurement.compiler: system C compiler with C11 O3 Wall Wextra Werror shared PIC; AVX2/FMA/F16C is function-targeted and runtime-authenticated

projection_context.latency_gate_derivation: 7.272727 ms is 2 percent of the 363.636 ms/token latency corresponding to the 2.75 tok/s breakthrough target
projection_context.interpretation: the all-64 projection is deliberately conservative; v37 admitted only two of three pilot layers

promotion_rules: run the frozen two-payload correctness and timing protocol once on quant
a numerical, latency, speedup, or stability gate failure is a terminal scientific rejection and must be retained
infrastructure-invalid work is neither a zero nor a completed result
a pass admits only the exact residual node to llama.cpp graph integration
llama.cpp must consume the compact payload directly and must not materialize high-precision factors or a dense residual matrix
whole-model free generation, WikiText, CUTE, MATH-500, code, MMLU, Q3_K_M/Q4_K_M throughput, resident memory, and energy gates remain mandatory
this microkernel cannot establish the 2.75 tok/s target or a scientific breakthrough
claim_boundary: A pass proves only that the exact v37 trained compact residual algebra has a numerically faithful, bounded-overhead AMD AVX2 implementation. It does not prove llama.cpp integration, whole-model quality, end-to-end speed, energy, novelty, or the requested breakthrough.
